newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet sees FIM 200 mln Partek/Sisu gain.
newsitem.headline: Valmet sees FIM 200 mln Partek/Sisu gain.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it would make an extraordinary gain of almost 200 million markka in connection with getting a 10.5 percent stake in the new Partek/Sisu group.
Construction materials and cargo handling equipment group Partek Oy Ab said earlier it will merge with state-owned vehicles maker Sisu Oy.
"Valmet ... will become a minority (10.5 percent) shareholder in the new Partek Corporation which will result from the intended merger of Sisu and Partek," Valmet said.
"Valmet will make extraordinary gains of nearly 200 million markka, calculated at current market values, from the exchange of its Sisu shares for Partek shares," it said.
Partek will purchase from Valmet 9,397,106 Sisu shares. In return, Partek is offering 5,090,839 Partek shares and about 33 million markka in cash.
Valmet, which now owns 25.4 percent of Sisu, will get a stake of about 10.5 percent in the new Partek-Sisu group, making Valmet its second largest owner, it said.
